description: Use to check if a European company is healthy before you deal with it: UK accounts overdue, size band and insolvency history; French headcount, turnover, net result and BODACC insolvency; Norwegian employees, bankruptcy, winding-up and filed accounts; Finnish bankruptcy and restructuring; Dutch insolvency with a KvK number. Verdict healthy, watch, distressed or limited_data. Costs 0.02 USDC via x402, or 10 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

country.description: ISO country: GB, FR, NO and FI have full signals; NL with kvk

id.description: Or a company number, e.g. SIREN 552032534

kvk.description: Dutch KvK number: adds the insolvency register

name: company_health
title: Company financial health signals (paid)
